Woot also has a promo where you can score 20% off games and gaming hardware with the code “SAVETOBER”, and new Woot customers get 30% off. LG 65" G6 OLED TV + Free $100 eGift Card, LG M7 Wireless Speaker, and Installation
LG - 65" Class G6 OLED evo AI 4K Smart webOS TV
LG’s flagship 4K OLED TV, the 65" class G6 Series, is a great deal during Best Buy’s DoorBOOsters sale . Not only do you get the stunning display for $1,400 off, but it also includes a $100 gift card and an LG Sound Suite M7 wireless speaker worth $400. You even get free delivery and installation. It’s an incredible package. As for the LG G6 Series, expect near-perfect blacks, near-instantaneous response times, and near-infinite contrast, with vibrant colors and impressive brightness from the OLED panel. It’s also great for gaming, with HDMI 2.1 ports, VRR support, and a 165Hz refresh rate.

Save $18 on Tomodachi Life for Switch and More Woot Game Deals
Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream - Switch
Woot has brought back its video game sale. While many of the top deals have sold out, there are still a few things you might want to grab. One highlight is a brand-new US version of Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream for Switch. It’s down to just $42.39 with the code “SAVETOBER”. New Woot customers can get it even cheaper. This simulation game lets you create custom Mii characters that populate an island while you help solve their problems as they unfold. In IGN’s Tomodachi Life review , Logan Plant described it as “a deeply funny and equally personal civilization simulator.”
4-Pack of Apple AirTags (2nd Gen) Hit New Low
A four-pack of Apple AirTags (2nd Generation) has dropped to a new low price at Amazon and Best Buy. These handy little tracking devices can live in luggage, on keys, or even on a pet. The AirTag pairs easily with an iPhone or iPad and connects seamlessly with Apple’s Find My app. Location sharing even lets your family and friends track certain items, too. This newest generation features improved precision finding, a louder speaker, the ability to ping from farther away, and more. As someone who constantly misplaces things, AirTags are a lifesaver.
Apple - 11-inch iPad A16 chip with Wi-Fi - 128GB
Apple - MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop - M5 chip with 10-core CPU and 8-core GPU - 16GB Memory - 512GB SSD
23% Off a PlayStation DualSense Controller
Whether you need another controller for your PS5 or a solid PC controller option, you can’t go wrong with the DualSense. Woot has the “New Open Box- Pristine” Midnight Black model for just $57.49 with the code “SAVETOBER”, and if you’re new to Woot, you can get it for $50.39. This excellent controller features reliable performance, a familiar design, adaptive triggers, and haptic feedback. There’s a reason it scored a 9/10 in IGN’s review.
Corsair TC100 Relaxed Gaming Chair for $131.99
Corsair TC100 Relaxed Gaming Chair - Leatherette
Best Buy’s DoorBOOsters sale runs until Monday, the first of several sales leading up to Black Friday at Best Buy . The Corsair TC100 Relaxed Gaming Chair is one exciting deal. It’s one of IGN’s top budget gaming chairs and is down to its lowest price yet, beating its Prime Big Deal Days discount. Holding up to 264lbs, accommodating heights up to 6' 2", and offering minimal bolstering, it fits a range of body types. Perforated leatherette provides better breathability. Plus, a plush foam seat provides the perfect amount of cushioning. Back and neck pillows aid in lumbar support, while a recline up to 160° and 2D armrests round out this awesome chair.
$32 Off a $200 PlayStation Store Gift Card
You’re unlikely to find a direct deal on GTA VI preorder before release day next month. However, Newegg is offering an incredible $32 discount on a $200 PlayStation Store Gift Card with the promo code “GTWF2795”, a great roundabout way to save. It’s one of the biggest gift card discounts I’ve seen on Newegg, and I write about those deals often. That $200 can get you the Ultimate Edition , plus you can buy other games, DLC, subscriptions, and more. After purchasing the gift card, it should arrive in your email shortly after for redemption at the PS Store.
$130 Off the Razer BlackShark V3 Pro Wireless ANC Gaming Headset
Razer BlackShark V3 Pro Wireless ANC Gaming Headset for Xbox
Whether it's the incredible stitched leather headband with woven sports-mesh wrapped earcups for comfort, or the well-rounded audio profile, the Razer BlackShark V3 Pro Wireless ANC Gaming Headset is excellent. Its positional audio and solid microphone clarity make it a true standout, and ANC is included for better focus. With a 2.4GHz dongle or USB-C to 3.5mm audio, and simultaneous Bluetooth, it’s a versatile headset. So, it's no surprise the Razer BlackShark V3 Pro earned 9/10 in IGN’s review . Right now, you can get a brand-new headset for just $119.99 with the code “SAVETOBER” at Woot. New customers get it for $104.99.
Get 20% Off the New SteelSeries Aeon Pro Gaming Controller
SteelSeries Aeon Pro Gaming Controller for Xbox, PC
The new SteelSeries Aeon Pro Gaming Controller is 20% off with code “SSPOUT20” at SteelSeries. It offers exceptional build quality, a unique hot-swappable battery system, Hall Effect joysticks, and mechanical switches. The sticks are even modular, and you can customize its 16 buttons via the controller’s OLED display or the GG app. A handy “quick switch” feature also makes it easy to switch from playing on Xbox to PC or mobile. For more, read IGN’s in-progress Aeon Pro review .
$150 Off an Excellent Condition Asus ROG Xbox Ally X
Asus ROG Xbox Ally X 7" 120Hz AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme Handheld Gaming PC (24GB/1TB)
The Asus ROG Xbox Ally X features an AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme processor that delivers plenty of oomph to tackle just about any AAA game. Its performance is on par with the recently released Xbox Ally X20. It’s even rocking the same GPU, plus 24GB of LPDDR5X RAM and a 1TB SSD as its successor. To make things even better, the ROG Xbox Ally X is $150 off at Best Buy when you opt for an Open Box "Excellent Condition" model. That’s the cheapest way to get the powerful AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme processor right now. To learn more about the handheld, read IGN’s Jackie Thomas’ ROG Xbox Ally X review .
Legion Go S 8" 120Hz Gaming Handheld - AMD Ryzen Z1 Extreme - SteamOS - 32GB with 1TB SSD
You can also pick up the LG Legion Go S for a good price at Best Buy.
Pokémon TCG: Prismatic Evolutions Elite Trainer Box
Best Buy has brought back invites to purchase the Prismatic Evolutions Elite Trainer Box for $49.99. It’s probably the easiest way to score this ETB at its MSRP. $49.99 is well below the market price. You’ll need a free Best Buy account to request an invite. If you get selected, you’ll have 24 hours to make the purchase. Nine boosters, a full-art foil Eevee promo card, 65 Eevee sleeves, a collector's storage box, and more come with the ETB.
Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Battle Deck
Amazon has reopened its invite requests to purchase the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box for just $59.99. That’s well below the market value, which is sitting around twice that amount. If you still want the ETB and don’t want to pay a fortune, it’s worth a shot. Even if you’re selected, you don’t have to buy. Keep checking your email; if selected, you'll have 72 hours to purchase.
$10 Off the LEGO NASA Artemis Space Launch System Rocket
LEGO Technic NASA Artemis Space Launch System Rocket 42221
The LEGO Technic NASA Artemis Space Launch System Rocket is down $10 at Amazon and Target. That’s just $2 more than the lowest price this popular LEGO set has ever been. It’s great for kids and adults alike who love all things space. This model of the rocket that launched astronauts to the moon earlier this year features 632 pieces and even includes 4 astronaut nanofigures. There’s also a crank for separating the rocket in three different stages.
Best Buy’s Black Friday sale may not be live just yet. However, you can score some incredible discounts on Bambu Lab 3D printers . The Bambu P2S is a solid all-around option for most users, mixing premium features for a midrange price. With a simple setup, a fully enclosed chamber, acceleration up to 20000 mm/s², and more, this 3D printer has a lot going for it. Plus, the combo includes the Automatic Material System (AMS).
Beyond the Bambu P2S, check out more incredible deals below:
$200 Off the 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 Gaming Monitor
27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 QHD 240Hz Gaming Monitor
The 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 is $200 off on Amazon ahead of Black Friday. This 2026 monitor features a QD-OLED panel for a brighter picture and a wider color gamut than a W-OLED monitor. It also delivers near-infinite contrast, true blacks, and near-instant response times. The 240Hz refresh rate in 1440p makes it great for esports and first-person shooters. You even get a 3-year warranty that covers potential OLED burn-in.
Phantom Blade Zero is officially here, and if you want to save a few bucks, GMG and Fanatical have you covered. A Steam code is 10-15% off. While not a huge discount, if you don’t want to miss the current hype around this action RPG, these are the best deals going. Phantom Blade Zero earned an “Amazing” 9/10 in IGN’s review . Reviewer Travis Northup said it “is one of the best action games I’ve played in a long time, with standout combat that never came even close to feeling old across 50 hours of playing.”
$700 Off the HyperX OMEN RTX 5060 Gaming Laptop
HyperX OMEN 15" AMD Ryzen 7 8745HX RTX 5060 Gaming Laptop (16GB/1TB)
Walmart has dropped the price of the HP HyperX OMEN Gaming Laptop by $700. It’s equipped with a GeForce RTX 5060 graphics card and an AMD Ryzen 7 8745HX CPU with a high boost clock, making it a solid gaming choice with more power than the Steam Machine. Those processors pair nicely with the 15.3" 2K 165Hz IPS display, while 16GB of DDR5 RAM and a 1TB SSD round it out.
$18 Off the Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike Wireless Gaming Mouse
Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE Wireless Gaming Mouse
The Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike Wireless Gaming Mouse is IGN’s top gaming mouse for a reason. To start, it features an innovative Haptic Inductive Trigger System (HITS), where electromagnetic sensors cut click latency and let you adjust feedback to your liking. In fact, the entire mouse is incredibly tunable. Then, you get the classic tried-and-true Logitech shape and speedy sensors. It’s not surprising the mouse earned a rare 10/10 rating in IGN’s review . Right now, you can get the rarely discounted mouse for 10% off; the final $18 discount is taken at checkout.
MTG x The Hobbit Play Booster Box Hits New Low
Magic: The Gathering - The Hobbit Play Booster Box
The Hobbit Universes Beyond set is down to just $139.99. That's its lowest price ever, bringing each Booster to $4.67. The 30 pack box also includes a foil box topper featuring a reprint with special borderless alt-art from The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth set.
Silent Hill 2 and More Spooky Game Discounts
It’s Halloween Weekend. To celebrate, retailers have dropped the prices of a bunch of scary video games . One highlight is Silent Hill 2. This remake of the survival-horror masterpiece originally released on PS2 will put you in a spooky mood with its grim atmosphere and demonic ghouls. In IGN’s Silent Hill 2 review , Tristan Ogilvie found it to be a “great way to visit – or revisit – one of the most dread-inducing destinations in the history of survival horror.”
Get a 256GB Samsung P9 MicroSD Express Card for $48
Last week, Amazon had the 512GB Samsung P9 MicroSD Express Card on sale, and now the 256GB option has dropped to its lowest price in months. For 47.99, you’ll get IGN’s top budget microSD Express card for Switch 2 . In fact, it’s just a couple bucks more than Walmart’s Onn microSD Express cards. But Samsung’s cards offer better longevity and deliver faster sequential read and write times, according to IGN’s testing . It’s the perfect option for your Switch 2, and you’ll likely need it. Many games will eat up that 256GB on the console fast.
